## Setup

```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ReactomePA)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r msigdb-setup}
# Fetch hallmark gene sets once (avoid re-downloading in every function call)
hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
hallmark_t2g  <- hallmark_sets[, c("gs_name", "entrez_gene")]
```

## Function Definitions

### KEGG

```{r function-kegg}
run_kegg_enrichment <- function(population, mutation, block, direction,
                                dotplot_dimensions = c(6, 4)) {
  # --- Build input path ---
  input_file <- sprintf("./_cache/diffex/%s_%s_%s_%s.txt",
                        population, mutation, block, direction)
  if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
    message(sprintf("  Gene list not found: %s — skipping.", input_file))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  # --- Read and validate gene list ---
  genes <- readLines(input_file)
  genes <- trimws(genes)
  genes <- genes[genes != ""]
  if (length(genes) < 10) {
    message(sprintf("  Only %d genes in %s — minimum 10 required. Skipping.",
                    length(genes), input_file))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  message(sprintf("  Loaded %d gene symbols from %s", length(genes), input_file))
  # --- Convert symbols to Entrez IDs ---
  mapped <- bitr(genes,
                 fromType = "SYMBOL",
                 toType   = "ENTREZID",
                 OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)
  n_input  <- length(genes)
  n_mapped <- nrow(mapped)
  n_lost   <- n_input - n_mapped
  message(sprintf("  Gene mapping: %d/%d mapped, %d lost", n_mapped, n_input, n_lost))
  if (n_mapped < 10) {
    message("  Fewer than 10 genes mapped after conversion — skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  # --- Run KEGG enrichment ---
  ke <- enrichKEGG(
    gene         = mapped$ENTREZID,
    organism     = "hsa",
    keyType      = "ncbi-geneid",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05
  )
  result_df <- as.data.frame(ke)
  if (nrow(result_df) == 0) {
    message("  No significantly enriched KEGG pathways found.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  message(sprintf("  Found %d enriched pathways", nrow(result_df)))
  # --- Convert Entrez IDs back to symbols in results ---
  ke_readable <- setReadable(ke, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  result_df   <- as.data.frame(ke_readable)
  # --- Output paths ---
  tag <- sprintf("%s_%s_%s_%s", population, mutation, block, direction)
  plot_file <- sprintf("./_figures/pathway_enrichment/kegg/%s_dotplot.png", tag)
  csv_file  <- sprintf("./_cache/pathway_enrichment/kegg/%s.csv", tag)
  dir.create(dirname(plot_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(dirname(csv_file),  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  # --- Dot plot ---
  p <- dotplot(ke_readable, showCategory = 10, font.size = 8) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8))
  ggsave(plot_file, p,
         width  = dotplot_dimensions[1],
         height = dotplot_dimensions[2],
         dpi    = 300)
  message(sprintf("  Dotplot saved: %s", plot_file))
  # --- CSV ---
  output_df <- data.frame(
    pathway_id   = result_df$ID,
    pathway_name = result_df$Description,
    p_adjust     = result_df$p.adjust,
    gene_count   = result_df$Count,
    gene_symbols = result_df$geneID,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(output_df, csv_file, row.names = FALSE)
  message(sprintf("  CSV saved: %s (%d pathways)", csv_file, nrow(output_df)))
  return(invisible(ke_readable))
}
```

### Reactome

```{r function-reactome}
run_reactome_enrichment <- function(population, mutation, block, direction,
                                    dotplot_dimensions = c(6, 4)) {
  # --- Build input path ---
  input_file <- sprintf("./_cache/diffex/%s_%s_%s_%s.txt",
                        population, mutation, block, direction)
  if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
    message(sprintf("  Gene list not found: %s — skipping.", input_file))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  # --- Read and validate gene list ---
  genes <- readLines(input_file)
  genes <- trimws(genes)
  genes <- genes[genes != ""]
  if (length(genes) < 10) {
    message(sprintf("  Only %d genes in %s — minimum 10 required. Skipping.",
                    length(genes), input_file))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  message(sprintf("  Loaded %d gene symbols from %s", length(genes), input_file))
  # --- Convert symbols to Entrez IDs ---
  mapped <- bitr(genes,
                 fromType = "SYMBOL",
                 toType   = "ENTREZID",
                 OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)
  n_input  <- length(genes)
  n_mapped <- nrow(mapped)
  n_lost   <- n_input - n_mapped
  message(sprintf("  Gene mapping: %d/%d mapped, %d lost", n_mapped, n_input, n_lost))
  if (n_mapped < 10) {
    message("  Fewer than 10 genes mapped after conversion — skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  # --- Run Reactome enrichment ---
  re <- enrichPathway(
    gene         = mapped$ENTREZID,
    organism     = "human",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05
  )
  result_df <- as.data.frame(re)
  if (nrow(result_df) == 0) {
    message("  No significantly enriched Reactome pathways found.")
    return(invisible(NULL))

  message(sprintf("  Found %d enriched pathways", nrow(result_df)))
  # --- Convert Entrez IDs back to symbols in results ---

  result_df   <- as.data.frame(re_readable)
  # --- Output paths ---
  tag <- sprintf("%s_%s_%s_%s", population, mutation, block, direction)
  plot_file <- sprintf("./_figures/pathway_enrichment/reactome/%s_dotplot.png", tag)

    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8))

         width  = dotplot_dimensions[1],
         height = dotplot_dimensions[2],
         dpi    = 300)
  message(sprintf("  Dotplot saved: %s", plot_file))
  # --- CSV ---
  output_df <- data.frame(
    pathway_id   = result_df$ID,
    pathway_name = result_df$Description,
    p_adjust     = result_df$p.adjust,
    gene_count   = result_df$Count,
    gene_symbols = result_df$geneID,

  write.csv(output_df, csv_file, row.names = FALSE)

  return(invisible(re_readable))
}
```

### MSigDB Hallmark

```{r function-hallmark}
run_hallmark_enrichment <- function(population, mutation, block, direction,
                                    dotplot_dimensions = c(6, 4)) {
  # --- Build input path ---
  input_file <- sprintf("./_cache/diffex/%s_%s_%s_%s.txt",
                        population, mutation, block, direction)
  if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
    message(sprintf("  Gene list not found: %s — skipping.", input_file))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  # --- Read and validate gene list ---
  genes <- readLines(input_file)
  genes <- trimws(genes)
  genes <- genes[genes != ""]
  if (length(genes) < 10) {
    message(sprintf("  Only %d genes in %s — minimum 10 required. Skipping.",
                    length(genes), input_file))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  message(sprintf("  Loaded %d gene symbols from %s", length(genes), input_file))
  # --- Convert symbols to Entrez IDs ---
  mapped <- bitr(genes,
                 fromType = "SYMBOL",
                 toType   = "ENTREZID",
                 OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)
  n_input  <- length(genes)
  n_mapped <- nrow(mapped)
  n_lost   <- n_input - n_mapped
  message(sprintf("  Gene mapping: %d/%d mapped, %d lost", n_mapped, n_input, n_lost))
  if (n_mapped < 10) {
    message("  Fewer than 10 genes mapped after conversion — skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  # --- Run Hallmark enrichment ---
  he <- enricher(
    gene         = mapped$ENTREZID,
    TERM2GENE    = hallmark_t2g,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05
  )
  result_df <- as.data.frame(he)
  if (nrow(result_df) == 0) {
    message("  No significantly enriched Hallmark gene sets found.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  message(sprintf("  Found %d enriched gene sets", nrow(result_df)))
  # --- Convert Entrez IDs back to symbols in results ---
  he_readable <- setReadable(he, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  result_df   <- as.data.frame(he_readable)
  # --- Clean up hallmark names (HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS → Apoptosis) ---
  result_df$Description <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", result_df$ID)
  result_df$Description <- gsub("_", " ", result_df$Description)
  result_df$Description <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(result_df$Description))
  # --- Output paths ---
  tag <- sprintf("%s_%s_%s_%s", population, mutation, block, direction)
  plot_file <- sprintf("./_figures/pathway_enrichment/hallmark/%s_dotplot.png", tag)
  csv_file  <- sprintf("./_cache/pathway_enrichment/hallmark/%s.csv", tag)
  dir.create(dirname(plot_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(dirname(csv_file),  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  # --- Dot plot ---
  p <- dotplot(he_readable, showCategory = 10, font.size = 8) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8))
  ggsave(plot_file, p,
         width  = dotplot_dimensions[1],
         height = dotplot_dimensions[2],
         dpi    = 300)
  message(sprintf("  Dotplot saved: %s", plot_file))
  # --- CSV ---
  output_df <- data.frame(
    gene_set_id   = result_df$ID,
    gene_set_name = result_df$Description,
    p_adjust      = result_df$p.adjust,
    gene_count    = result_df$Count,
    gene_symbols  = result_df$geneID,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(output_df, csv_file, row.names = FALSE)
  message(sprintf("  CSV saved: %s (%d gene sets)", csv_file, nrow(output_df)))
  return(invisible(he_readable))
}
```

## Run All Combinations

```{r run-all, results='asis'}
populations <- c("B", "W")
mutations   <- c("NPM1-WT", "FLT3-ITD-WT", "FLT3-ITDxNPM1-WT")
blocks      <- c("Transcriptomics", "Proteomics", "Lipid-Protein-Associations")
directions  <- c("up", "down")

combos <- expand.grid(
  population = populations,
  mutation   = mutations,
  block      = blocks,
  direction  = directions,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message(sprintf("Running enrichment for %d combinations × 3 databases\n", nrow(combos)))

results_kegg     <- list()
results_reactome <- list()
results_hallmark <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  row <- combos[i, ]
  tag <- sprintf("%s | %s | %s | %s",
                 row$population, row$mutation, row$block, row$direction)

  message(sprintf("\n========== [%d/%d] %s ==========", i, nrow(combos), tag))

  message("\n--- KEGG ---")
  result <- run_kegg_enrichment(
    population = row$population,
    mutation   = row$mutation,
    block      = row$block,
    direction  = row$direction
  )
  if (!is.null(result)) results_kegg[[tag]] <- result

  message("\n--- Reactome ---")
  result <- run_reactome_enrichment(
    population = row$population,
    mutation   = row$mutation,
    block      = row$block,
    direction  = row$direction
  )
  if (!is.null(result)) results_reactome[[tag]] <- result

  message("\n--- Hallmark ---")
  result <- run_hallmark_enrichment(
    population = row$population,
    mutation   = row$mutation,
    block      = row$block,
    direction  = row$direction
  )
  if (!is.null(result)) results_hallmark[[tag]] <- result
}

message(sprintf(
  "\nDone. Results: KEGG %d/%d, Reactome %d/%d, Hallmark %d/%d",
  length(results_kegg), nrow(combos),
  length(results_reactome), nrow(combos),
  length(results_hallmark), nrow(combos)
))
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
build_summary <- function(results, database_name) {
  if (length(results) == 0) return(NULL)
  rows <- lapply(names(results), function(tag) {
    df <- as.data.frame(results[[tag]])
    data.frame(
      database       = database_name,
      comparison     = tag,
      n_pathways     = nrow(df),
      top_pathway    = df$Description[1],
      top_p_adjust   = signif(df$p.adjust[1], 3),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

summary_df <- rbind(
  build_summary(results_kegg,     "KEGG"),
  build_summary(results_reactome, "Reactome"),
  build_summary(results_hallmark, "Hallmark")
)

if (!is.null(summary_df) && nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(summary_df, caption = "Enrichment results overview")
} else {
  message("No enriched pathways found in any comparison or database.")
}
```
